pages.text: The year turns through four seasons, and each crop has its own. Out of season it barely grows. A seed's tooltip lists its seasons.$(br2)Deep underground, below y 48, the seasons don't reach your crops.
Winter brings snow to places that never see it. A $(l:world/seasons#calendar)Calendar$(/l) tells you how long until the next turn.
Shows the season and how far into it you are.
